me.name: Kamyar Kamali
me.skill: I'm a front-end developer specializing in JavaScript, React, Next.js, and WordPress. I design fast, responsive, and SEO-friendly websites.

services.desc1: Development of fast, responsive, and optimized user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Next.js to provide a professional and modern user experience.
services.desc2: Design and implementation of WordPress websites using Elementor and WooCommerce, optimized for SEO and easily editable by the client.
services.desc3: Designing clean and modern UIs using Tailwind CSS and UI frameworks like Shadcn and MUI, suitable for scalable projects.
services.title4: Landing Page, E-commerce & Corporate Website Design
services.desc4: Design and coding of professional, responsive e-commerce, corporate websites, and landing pages using front-end technologies and WordPress, tailored to client needs and modern standards.
services.desc5: Finding and fixing JavaScript bugs and optimizing script performance to increase speed and provide a smoother user experience in front-end projects.

info.descriptionme: I’m Kamyar Kamali, a front-end and WordPress developer with over 4 years of active experience designing and building responsive websites and applications. Throughout my career, I have collaborated with various companies, mastering skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, modern frameworks like React and Next.js, as well as WordPress development and customization. My goal is to create beautiful and user-friendly interfaces that enhance the digital experience.
info.title: My Ecperience
info.desc: I’m Kamyar Kamali, a front-end developer specialized in JavaScript, React, Next.js, WordPress, and Elementor. I create fast, responsive, and user-friendly websites that deliver exceptional user experiences.
info.myskills: My skills include front-end development using JavaScript, React, and Next.js, designing and developing WordPress websites with Elementor, and optimizing user interfaces for better user experience.

project.description1: The client owned a WordPress-based online store and, due to performance and security concerns, requested a custom-coded version of the website. I was responsible for the front-end development, which was implemented using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
project.description2: Due to the client's specific design preferences, the store theme was fully custom-designed and developed using HTML, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript. The final template was then integrated into WordPress
